confirmation_gate.accounting_correction: Historical E01 reviews counted all active teacher selection requests. The frozen training corpus excludes 402 deterministic forced calls from policy loss while retaining them for recurrence.

excluded_from_qualified_training.rule: Historical Luca, provenance-only, and same-submission consistency files remain immutable evidence but are excluded from the current two-teacher qualified corpus.

split_contract.algorithm: Within each teacher_key x seat/result stratum, sort by SHA256("KPTCG-E01-APPROVED-CORPUS-V1:" + episode_id); allocate at least one test and validation episode per stratum, remainder train.

supervision_contract.compound_action: Preserve complete ordered selections without replacement.
supervision_contract.forced_recurrence: Forced calls advance recurrent state and remain in sequence context but produce no policy loss.
supervision_contract.lag_alignment: Action at step t is supervised against the preceding active selection request.
supervision_contract.legal_option_mask: Retain the exact legal option mask at each recurrent selection position.
supervision_contract.recurrence: Preserve player ownership, request order, recurrence boundaries, terminal/truncation boundaries, and full ordered multi-selection semantics.
supervision_contract.stop: STOP is a first-class target whenever the active request permits stopping.
